rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action or event frightens or startles someone.

example.english: You suddenly spoke behind me just now—you really did scare me!
example.traditional: 你頭先突然喺我後面出聲，真係嚇親我喇！
example.jyutping: nei5 tau4 sin1 dat6 jin4 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 ceot1 seng1 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for being afraid or for saying that someone is easily frightened, rather than for causing the fear.

example.english: I scare easily, so I don't watch horror films.
example.traditional: 我好易驚，所以唔睇恐怖片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 ji6 ging1 so2 ji5 m4 tai2 hung2 bou3 pin2
